newsitem.title: UK: BFI up seven, Panamaxes firmer.
newsitem.headline: BFI up seven, Panamaxes firmer.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose seven points on Tuesday to 1,434 and owners were expressing more confidence in the immediate prospects for Panamaxes in most areas.
Firmer rates were reported from USGulf, for example Andre conceded $25.25 for 55,000 heavy grain USGulf to Malaysia for first half December.
brokers also reported stronger demand from the Plate where rates were believed to be rising for Panamaxes and Handy-sizes.
But the market for handies elsewhere and for Capers in most areas was lacking decisive direction.

BIFFEX moved ahead strongly reflecting the renewewd optimism for the market's prospects between now and the Christmas holiday period. It gained between 39 and 20 points in the active positions where the volume reached a total of 350 lots.
